purpose: Preserve the audit history of control-migration questions without allowing CONTROL_PLANE_MAINTENANCE to self-grant task-publication, Driver, Steward, theorem-review, or Foundation authority. A request is open only while its related migration genuinely requires semantic verification. Once the current values already equal the canonical values and no field mutation remains to authorize, the request is retained as closed non-executable history rather than converted into a synthetic governance task.

requests.question: Can the six V1 task-publication control pointers be migrated to immutable V2 authority without changing any mathematical/research governance semantics carried by research_architecture.json?

resolution.reason: The six registered architecture pointers already equal their canonical immutable-V2 values. The current control operation proposes and performs no mutation of research_architecture.json, so there is no mixed-semantics field change left for an authorized governance task to approve. The former request is retained only as provenance.

required_verification_completed: The exact six JSON pointers and V2 values are registered.
All six current values already equal the registered canonical values.
Removing the six target pointers leaves identical non-target JSON structure.
No architecture write is required or authorized by this request.
forbidden_shortcuts: treating a closed request as Driver or Foundation approval
changing wording or values outside the six registered pointers
creating a synthetic governance task when no field mutation remains
